name: modz
description: The MODZ hub: opens on the right when a session starts; agents, files, plan, tests, checkpoints, replay, usage, look and every mod, one click away

openOnStart.title: Open at session start
openOnStart.description: Open the MODZ hub on the right every time a session starts

keepUpdated.title: Keep mods up to date
keepUpdated.description: Turn on Claude Code's own auto-update for the MODZ marketplace once, so every mod you installed (transceiver included) updates itself. A choice you already made under /plugin is kept.

keepReplyLanguage.title: Keep the reply language
keepReplyLanguage.description: After English tool output or a subagent's English report, remind Claude once per turn to reply in your language (Claude Code's language setting, else MODZ_LANG=tr). No model call.
